name: Template: Content Production
description: Manage content from idea through publication. Each swimlane is a content channel; each card is a piece of content.

swimlanes.name: Blog & SEO
swimlanes.notes: Long-form SEO content. Target: 2 posts/week. Primary traffic driver. Owner: content team.

swimlanes.name: Social Media
swimlanes.notes: Twitter/X, LinkedIn, short-form video (TikTok, Reels). 2-3 posts/day across channels.

swimlanes.name: Video Production
swimlanes.notes: Product demos, thought leadership webinars, YouTube tutorials. Studio booking required.

swimlanes.name: Email Campaigns
swimlanes.notes: Weekly newsletter, drip sequences, product announcements. Audience: 28,000 subscribers.

swimlanes.name: Product Documentation
swimlanes.notes: User guides, API docs, release notes. Must be versioned. Published to docs.visiban.com.

swimlanes.name: Case Studies
swimlanes.notes: Customer stories. Requires customer approval. 4-6 week production time per study.

swimlanes.name: Webinars & Events
swimlanes.notes: Live webinars, conference talks, virtual workshops. Lead capture forms required.

swimlanes.name: Press & PR
swimlanes.notes: Press releases, media pitches, analyst briefings. All external comms require CEO approval.

swimlanes.name: Partner Content
swimlanes.notes: Co-branded content with integration partners. Joint approval workflow required.

swimlanes.name: Internal Communications
swimlanes.notes: All-hands decks, internal newsletters, culture posts. Published to company wiki.
